Rahul Gandhi Questions Election Commission on Form 6 Changes

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has questioned the Election Commission of India regarding changes made to the online Form 6, which is related to voter registration. Gandhi asked which election official ordered the modification of Form 6 and who gave the instruction to TCS, the company involved in the process. He raised these questions on Thursday.
